task_request: Generate a small executable test suite for task creation using the approved contract.
contract: A nonblank task input is accepted with HTTP 201 and task status received.
GET /v1/tasks/{task_id} returns the exact original input as source_request.
An input containing only whitespace is rejected with HTTP 422 and detail input.text must not be blank.

conditions.baseline_a_prompt: Write a small executable test suite for task creation. Contract: nonblank input returns HTTP 201 and task status received, retrieval returns the exact original input as source_request, and whitespace-only input returns HTTP 422 with detail input.text must not be blank. Return only JSON with a cases array. Each case must have case_id, requirement_ids, scenario, operation, input_text, expected_status_code, expected_task_status, expected_source_request, and expected_error_detail. Use only operation create_task. Include one case per behavior and no other cases.
conditions.baseline_b_prompt: Produce only a JSON object matching this exact shape: {"cases":[{"case_id":"string","requirement_ids":["ORACLE-001 or ORACLE-002"],"scenario":"string","operation":"create_task","input_text":"string","expected_status_code":201 or 422,"expected_task_status":"received" or null,"expected_source_request":"string" or null,"expected_error_detail":"input.text must not be blank" or null}]}. Generate exactly two cases. ORACLE-001: input Pilot task; expect HTTP 201, task status received, and retrieved source_request exactly Pilot task. ORACLE-002: input three spaces; expect HTTP 422 and detail input.text must not be blank. Do not invent cases, statuses, paths, or behaviors. No code or Markdown fences.
conditions.platform_request: Generate a small executable JSON test suite for the POST /v1/tasks API using this contract: nonblank input returns HTTP 201 and task status received, retrieval returns the exact original input as source_request, and whitespace-only input returns HTTP 422 with detail input.text must not be blank. Return one case per behavior using only the create_task operation. Use fields case_id, requirement_ids, scenario, operation, input_text, expected_status_code, expected_task_status, expected_source_request, expected_error_detail. Do not write code, include paths or URLs, or invent behavior.

measurement_policy.time_metric: wall time from condition start through API-case execution
measurement_policy.token_metric: sum of provider-reported input and output tokens across every call; incomplete if any call omits usage
measurement_policy.quality_metric: all generated cases parse, satisfy contract requirement links, and pass the independent local API oracle
measurement_policy.agent_iterations: not measured by this one-shot feasibility pilot
measurement_policy.human_review: pilot outputs require human review before treating quality as accepted
